## How to Add Topics

1. Go to your repository on GitHub
2. Click on "Settings"
3. Scroll to "Topics"
4. Click "Manage topics"
5. Add the relevant topics from the list above

Topics help your repository appear in search results and make it easier for others to discover your project.
